 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Overlay the two grids across the color-3/7 divider; mark overlaps."""
    if not grid:
        return []
    if all(value == 3 for value in grid[len(grid) // 2]):
        # Horizontal separator: matching nonzero cells above/below.
        sep = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 3 for v in row))
        top, bottom = grid[:sep], grid[sep + 1:]
        return [[2 if a != 0 and b != 0 else 0 for a, b in zip(ra, rb)]
                for ra, rb in zip(top, bottom)]
    # Vertical separator: matching 1/9 cells on either side.
    sep = next(j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if all(row[j] == 7 for row in grid))
    left = [row[:sep] for row in grid]
    right = [row[sep + 1:] for row in grid]
    return [[2 if a != 0 and b != 0 else 0 for a, b in zip(ra, rb)]
            for ra, rb in zip(left, right)]
